title: 第378章 裂天之影第377章 血脉的延续
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
第378章裂天之影
新烬镇。
或者说，如今已经没有人再用“镇”来称呼这片土地，而是敬畏地唤它为——新烬城。
一年光阴，对于这片被迷雾诅咒的废土而言，本该只是漫长绝望中微不足道的喘息。
但自从那日亚修正式晋升三阶后，整个新烬领的迷雾，便以肉眼可见的速度一天天变淡。
如今，即便走出了中央“薪阳”的绝对庇护范围，荒野上的能见度也已破天荒地达到了三四十米。
那种仿佛要将人溺死的逼仄与绝望，被彻底撕碎。
而随之而来的，便是在亚修的铁腕统治下，这片土地翻天覆地的繁华与改变。
以原本的新烬镇为圆心，一圈厚重的外城墙在短短一年内拔地而起。
曾经零散分布周围的庄园与营地，如今被整编成了规整的街区，犹如众星拱月般围绕着中央。
加上不断涌入的流民与商队，如今的新烬城，人口已悄然逼近五千大关。
但这翻天覆地的变化，仅仅只是新烬子爵领的缩影。
这一年里，亚修从未停下脚步。
随着“晶币”被确立为领地内唯一的法定货币。
一条条平整的泥土路顺着指路牌的指引，像血管一样在数万平方公里的荒原上铺展开来。
政令清晨从城堡下达，日落前便能传遍边陲。
西部的黄金米、东部的矿石，顺着血管般的道路源源不断地汇聚于中央集市。
为了彻底掌控这数万平方公里的广袤领地，亚修划定了四大镇守。
西部铁壁庄园，卡尔坐镇；北部黑木庄园，西奥巡狩；东部紫藤庄园，盖尔扼守。
而南部……

随着领地发展与阶位稳固，亚修的【封君】名额再增一人。
汉克，这位出身正规军的稳重老兵如愿获得了这份恩赐，携新立的“银松庄园”镇守南方。
至此，新烬城四方镇守彻底成型。
除了汉克刚刚接受敕赐尚需沉淀外。
其余三人早已在这一年的杀戮与资源倾斜下，达到了二阶LV.10的满级，成为了真正意义上的“伪三阶”。
四座以他们为核心的要塞庄园，犹如四根粗壮的钉子，将新烬领这数万平方公里的广袤疆域死死钉牢。
除此之外，内政方面亦是井井有条。
艾尔莎牵头，在内城建起了第一座草药医院。
克莱恩推倒了简易的木棚，建起了更宏伟的圣堂，培养着一批批忠于新烬的年轻教士。
埃德温如愿以偿地拥有了一座带独立图书馆的三层法师塔，文书与学徒们在里面日夜推演。
至于莉娜和格雷，则挂着正副会长的头衔，将工匠公会经营得风生水起，每天都有新式武备运往四方。
最让人啼笑皆非的，是人口的繁衍。
或许是亚修这位领主大人“身先士卒”的榜样作用，又或许是这安稳富足的秩序给了领民们底气。
短短一年，新烬领内竟掀起了一股令人瞠目结舌的生育狂潮。
走在街上，大着肚子的孕妇随处可见。
男人们干活愈发卖力，女人们脸上多了喜色。
不用别人描述，每个人都能看到希望。
所有人都相信，只要给这位大人足够的时间，这片土地迟早会建立起庞大的伯国，甚至是屹立于迷雾中的帝国。
然而。
平静，终究是这片迷雾中最奢侈的易碎品。

第378章裂天之影
书房内，亚修正翻阅着埃德温递交的开荒账册，动作猛地一顿。
他没有抬头，那双漆黑的眸子却在瞬间缩成了针尖大小。
【掠食者感知】在疯狂跳动，犹如一根被狠狠拨断的琴弦，在脑海深处刺耳地嗡鸣。
content_en:
Chapter 378 The Shadow that Split the Sky
New Ember Town.
In other words, no one now calls this land "town" anymore, but instead calls it - New Ember City with awe.
One year, for this wasteland cursed by the fog, should have been just an insignificant respite in the long despair.
But since that day when Yaxiu was officially promoted to the third level, the fog in the entire New Ember Territory has become lighter day by day at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Now, even outside the absolute protection range of the central "Xinyang", the visibility in the wilderness has reached an unprecedented 30 to 40 meters.
The cramped feeling and despair that seemed to drown people were completely torn apart.
What followed was the earth-shaking prosperity and changes in this land under Ash's iron-fisted rule.
With the original Xinjin Town as the center, a thick outer city wall was built in just one year.
The manors and camps that were once scattered around were now organized into regular blocks, surrounding the center like stars over the moon.
Coupled with the continuous influx of refugees and caravans, the population of New Ember City has quietly approached the five thousand mark.
But this earth-shaking change is just a microcosm of the new Viscounty of Ash.
During this year, Ash never stopped.
With "crystal coins" being established as the only legal tender in the territory.
Following the guidance of the signposts, smooth dirt roads spread like blood vessels across tens of thousands of square kilometers of wasteland.
Government orders were issued from the castle in the early morning and spread throughout the borders before sunset.
Golden rice from the west and ore from the east are continuously gathered in the central market along the blood vessel-like road.
In order to completely control this vast territory of tens of thousands of square kilometers, Ash has designated four major guards.
In the western Iron Wall Manor, Karl is in charge; in the northern Blackwood Manor, Theo is patrolling; in the eastern Wisteria Manor, Gale is guarding it.
And the south...
With the development of the territory and the stabilization of the rank, Yaxiu's quota of [Monarch] has been increased by one more person.
Hank, a steady veteran of the regular army, received this gift as he wished and took the newly established "Silver Pine Manor" to guard the south.
At this point, the new city's four-sided defense has been completely formed.
Except that Hank has just accepted the gift and still needs to settle.
The remaining three have already reached the full level of the second level LV.10 due to this year's killing and resource tilt, and have become "pseudo third level" in the true sense.
The four fortresses and manors with them as the core were like four thick nails, nailing the vast territory of tens of thousands of square kilometers of the New Ember Territory tightly.
In addition, the internal affairs are also in good order.
Elsa took the lead and built the first herbal medicine hospital in the inner city.
Klein knocked down the simple wooden shed, built a more magnificent church, and trained batches of young priests who were loyal to Xinjin.
Edwin got his wish and got a three-story mage tower with an independent library, where clerks and apprentices worked day and night.
As for Lina and Gray, they hold the titles of president and vice-president and run the Craftsmen Guild in a prosperous manner, with new weapons shipped to all directions every day.
The most ridiculous thing is the reproduction of the population.
Perhaps it was Ash, the lord, who set an example by "taking the lead", or perhaps it was the stable and prosperous order that gave the citizens confidence.
In just one year, there was a jaw-dropping fertility craze in the New Ember Territory.
Walking on the street, pregnant women with big bellies can be seen everywhere.
The men worked harder and harder, and the women's faces became more joyful.
No one needs to describe it, everyone can see hope.
Everyone believes that as long as this gentleman is given enough time, this land will sooner or later establish a huge country, or even an empire standing in the mist.
However.
Peace is, after all, the most luxurious and fragile product in this fog.
Chapter 378 The Shadow that Split the Sky
In the study, Ashimu suddenly paused while flipping through the land reclamation account book submitted by Edwin.
He didn't look up, those dark eyesHis eyes shrank to the size of a pinhead in an instant.
[Predator Sense] is beating crazily, like a string that has been severely plucked, buzzing harshly in the depths of my mind.
